video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Taurean Prince l 10.01.26

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on adjusting to the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: It's been good, refreshing, challenging to say the least. Being challenged in different ways than I have in the past.
quotes.quote: It's been good, refreshing, challenging to say the least. Being challenged in different ways than I have in the past, but it's only making me better.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince says his transition to the Pistons has been refreshing and challenging, noting that he is being asked to do things he has not done in the past to help the team.

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on his relationship with JB Bickerstaff
quotes.excerpt: It's always good when you know people. I've been around the block a little bit.
quotes.quote: It's always good when you know people. I've been around the block a little bit, so I know him and a couple others on the staff and a couple of my teammates I used to have in the past too, so that helps with the transition for sure.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince says his familiarity with head coach JB Bickerstaff and other staff members has made his transition to Detroit much easier.

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on the challenges of training camp
quotes.excerpt: Just peak conditioning, just doing things I haven't been asked to do offensively and defensively.
quotes.quote: Just peak conditioning, just doing things I haven't been asked to do offensively and defensively, but it's whatever is best for the team and I know it's going to make me better, so I'm with it.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince says he is being pushed in new ways during Pistons training camp, specifically regarding his offensive and defensive responsibilities.

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on building team chemistry during the summer
quotes.excerpt: It's always good to be able to connect with people, especially in the summertime.
quotes.quote: It's always good to be able to connect with people, especially in the summertime, you kind of get a head start on that camaraderie. For me, I don't ever want to sound like a broken record, so I'm trying to just input where I see best fit and holding each other accountable just like they do with me.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince emphasizes the importance of building camaraderie during the summer and holding teammates accountable as he settles into his new role with the Pistons.

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on the Pistons' recent turnaround
quotes.excerpt: There wasn't really a surprise because of the staffing and everybody that they had over here.
quotes.quote: There wasn't really a surprise because of the staffing and everybody that they had over here. Like I said, I've had experience with JB, so I know what he brings to the table. I know what he expects out of his players, so to me, it really wasn't a surprise that they made the turnaround. I'm just glad to be here and to be a part of it.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince says he was not surprised by the Pistons recent turnaround because he knew exactly what to expect from JB Bickerstaff as a head coach.

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on his recovery from injury
quotes.excerpt: That was a very, very hard time, a dark time in my life.
quotes.quote: That was a very, very hard time, a dark time in my life. People don't know, but I had the injury on one day and I played in Toronto the very next day. My doctor told me if I would have took a wrong hit, I could have been a vegetable. That was his quote, so I was very blessed. All I was worried about was getting back.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince reveals the severity of a past injury, sharing that his doctor told him he could have been a vegetable if he had taken a wrong hit while playing through the issue.

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on joining the Pistons via trade
quotes.excerpt: Jared Jack, he was my vet in Atlanta, so I think he is a spokesman on my behalf.
quotes.quote: I was actually in Miami a few days before I linked up with the guys to work out and it was just a perfect sync in my opinion. Jared Jack, he was my vet in Atlanta, so I think he is a spokesman on my behalf to be here and to try to be acquired. Like I said, I'm blessed to be a part of the group and I'm just here to help win games.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince credits former teammate and current coach Jared Jack for helping facilitate his move to the Detroit Pistons.

quotes.speaker: Taurean Prince
quotes.summary_phrase: Taurean Prince on the identity of the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: Get stops and go score. Get stops first though.
quotes.quote: Get stops and go score. Get stops first though.
quotes.social_post: Taurean Prince defines the identity of the new look Pistons as simple, stating the team focus is to get stops first and then go score.
